tools.description: Provide only an input grid. The environment applies the verifier and shows the resulting gold input-output pair to the student.

content.text:
I'll analyze the verifier and create 4 diverse demonstration pairs.

The rule: split the 9×4 grid at the middle yellow row, take the top 4×4 and bottom 4×4, find their common color, and mark green where both sections have that common color.
